subject: Delay slider update until mouse button is released

messages.author: d16ad2363b1378ab
messages.subject: Delay slider update until mouse button is released
parts:
Hi -

Fairly new to Shiny, and I really appreciate its usability.  One issue I'm having is with input sliders.  When I click the circle to move the slider, Shiny will routinely update dependent outputs before I've moved the slider into the position I want.  From a user perspective, this is really annoying, especially when it takes several seconds to run the processes to update all of the outputs.  Is there a way, other than isolating the whole thing and making the user click an "update" button, to have Shiny wait to invalidate and trigger updates to dependent outputs until the user releases the mouse button?

Thanks,
Andrew
